combat_scale_note: Compact combat scale: ordinary level-one enemies usually begin around 4-9 HP and 1-2 ATK; chapter bosses use low tens of HP. Stats grow by small flat increments per enemy level.
enemy_scaling: stage_level_stats = base + growth_per_level * (stage_level - 1); apply boss phase multipliers after scaling.
targeting_contract: All enemy intent telegraphs are visible before resolution; story bosses cannot hard-lock progress with an uncounterable mechanic.
necropolis_reference_note: Heroes of Might and Magic III's Necropolis tier ladder is used as a broad role-progression reference (swarm, durable dead, specter, hunter, ranged caster, elite knight, colossal threat). All names, factions, silhouettes, lore and mechanics in this pack are original.
